question: How much revenue did each product department bring in during 2023?
golden_sql: SELECT p.department, ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS realized_revenue FROM `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_order_items` oi JOIN `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_products` p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.is_realized_revenue = TRUE AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.created_at) = 2023 GROUP BY p.department ORDER BY realized_revenue DESC;

question: How much revenue did each country generate in 2024?
golden_sql: SELECT u.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS realized_revenue FROM `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_order_items` oi JOIN `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_users` u ON oi.user_id = u.user_id WHERE oi.is_realized_revenue = TRUE AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.created_at) = 2024 GROUP BY u.country ORDER BY realized_revenue DESC;

question: Which 5 brands earned the most in 2023?
golden_sql: SELECT p.brand, ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS realized_revenue FROM `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_order_items` oi JOIN `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_products` p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.is_realized_revenue = TRUE AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.created_at) = 2023 GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY realized_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the average order value for customers from each acquisition source?
golden_sql: SELECT u.acquisition_source, ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id), 2) AS average_order_value FROM `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_order_items` oi JOIN `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_users` u ON oi.user_id = u.user_id WHERE oi.is_realized_revenue = TRUE GROUP BY u.acquisition_source ORDER BY average_order_value DESC;

question: Which traffic source has the highest share of orders with suspicious shipping timelines?
golden_sql: SELECT traffic_source, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COUNTIF(has_timeline_anomaly) AS anomaly_orders, ROUND(100 * SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(has_timeline_anomaly), COUNT(*)), 2) AS anomaly_share_pct FROM `apex-activewear.silver_layer.int_order_attribution` GROUP BY traffic_source ORDER BY anomaly_share_pct DESC;

question: How many users show website activity from before they registered?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oe.user_id) AS users_with_pre_registration_events FROM `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_users` u JOIN `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_online_events` oe ON u.user_id = oe.user_id WHERE oe.created_at < u.created_at;

question: Are there any order items with an invalid price?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_price_items FROM `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_order_items` WHERE sale_price < 0 OR sale_price IS NULL;

question: Is our revenue over-dependent on any single traffic source?
golden_sql: WITH source_revenue AS (SELECT a.traffic_source, SUM(oi.sale_price) AS revenue FROM `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_order_items` oi JOIN `apex-activewear.silver_layer.int_order_attribution` a ON oi.order_id = a.order_id WHERE oi.is_realized_revenue = TRUE GROUP BY a.traffic_source), shares AS (SELECT traffic_source, ROUND(100 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM source_revenue) SELECT traffic_source, share_pct FROM shares WHERE share_pct > 20 ORDER BY share_pct DESC;

question: Who are our 10 biggest spenders that are likely to leave?
golden_sql: SELECT user_id, total_historical_spend, churn_probability FROM `apex-activewear.gold_layer.customer_churn_scores` WHERE is_churn_risk = TRUE ORDER BY total_historical_spend DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which distribution center is the biggest bottleneck in our delivery times?
golden_sql: SELECT distribution_center, avg_fulfillment_latency_days FROM `apex-activewear.gold_layer.mart_dc_fulfillment` ORDER BY avg_fulfillment_latency_days DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What share of our customers falls into each value tier?
golden_sql: SELECT customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customers, ROUND(100 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM `apex-activewear.gold_layer.mart_ltv_12m_segmentation` GROUP BY customer_segment ORDER BY customers DESC;

question: What percentage of our customers have bought more than once?
golden_sql: SELECT ROUND(100 * SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(lifetime_orders > 1), COUNT(*)), 2) AS repeat_customer_pct FROM `apex-activewear.silver_layer.int_user_lifecycle`;

question: How many completed orders did each distribution center handle in 2024?
golden_sql: SELECT d.name AS distribution_center, COUNT(*) AS realized_orders FROM `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_orders` o JOIN `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_distribution_centers` d ON o.distribution_center_id = d.id WHERE o.is_realized_order = TRUE AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = 2024 GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY realized_orders DESC;

question: Which product category made the most profit in 2024?
golden_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.gross_margin_amount), 2) AS gross_margin FROM `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_order_items` oi JOIN `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_products` p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.is_realized_revenue = TRUE AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.created_at) = 2024 GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY gross_margin DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which distribution centers have the most orders with impossible shipping dates?
golden_sql: SELECT d.name AS distribution_center, COUNTIF(a.has_timeline_anomaly) AS anomaly_orders FROM `apex-activewear.silver_layer.int_order_attribution` a JOIN `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_orders` o ON a.order_id = o.order_id JOIN `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_distribution_centers` d ON o.distribution_center_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY anomaly_orders DESC;

question: How much did each paying customer spend on average in 2023, by acquisition source?
golden_sql: SELECT u.acquisition_source, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(oi.sale_price), COUNT(DISTINCT oi.user_id)), 2) AS revenue_per_customer FROM `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_order_items` oi JOIN `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_users` u ON oi.user_id = u.user_id WHERE oi.is_realized_revenue = TRUE AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.created_at) = 2023 GROUP BY u.acquisition_source ORDER BY revenue_per_customer DESC;

question: How many website events did each traffic source generate in 2024, counting only activity after the user signed up?
golden_sql: SELECT oe.traffic_source, COUNT(*) AS events FROM `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_online_events` oe JOIN `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_users` u ON oe.user_id = u.user_id WHERE oe.created_at >= u.created_at AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oe.created_at) = 2024 GROUP BY oe.traffic_source ORDER BY events DESC;
